title: JSON & JSONB Documents and Native Arrays
description: Store, query, and index JSONB documents and native PostgreSQL arrays using operators ->, ->>, @>, and GIN indexing.

data.text: PostgreSQL offers two JSON data types: `JSON` (stored as exact text representation) and **`JSONB`** (decomposed binary format). JSONB is slightly slower to insert because it parses the JSON structure, but provides lightning-fast querying, key lookup, and can be indexed with GIN (Generalized Inverted Index).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Always prefer `JSONB` over plain `JSON` for production querying.
Use GIN indexes with the containment operator `@>` for sub-millisecond document queries.
